about: Hand-reviewed patches that the classifiers cannot find (FINDINGS 3a, 5a). VAs assume image base 0x140000000.

patches.note: assign_avatar(mgr, idx, actor): idx < 2 -> < 4 (guard too far from its access for SlotBounds)
GetPlayerObject(mgr, idx): idx < 2 -> < 4; also bounded by the +0xd8 array count
join event callback: only while player_count < 2 -> < 4
join handler: input->count() (+0xd0) -> input->first_free_player() (+0xd8); -1 when none
join handler: unsigned index >= 2 -> >= 4 bails (also catches -1)
join handler: assign(1, pad) -> assign(free_index, pad): MOV EDX,EAX; MOV RCX,[input] (disp re-encoded); MOV RAX,[RCX]; MOV R8D,ESI; NOP3

hooks.note: bind(avatar, level_info, start): Rust mirror with the joining player's index instead of 1
ScreenJoinIn cancel: release the joining index (not 1), then the shared tail 0x1400e7450
avatar-by-class lookup: unchanged except calls from the pick handler skip player-owned avatars
join handler failure path: release(1) -> release(joining index)

deferred.note: join handler failure path releases player 1, not the new index; rare (join screen failed to open)
FUN_1400ee9b0 indexes slots with R14 (another player's index?), no guard; check at runtime
FUN_1401b4270 CMP EAX,2 JGE on an unknown 2-entry array
